analysis_results_output_xor_reason_check.name: analysis_results_output_xor_reason_check
analysis_results_output_xor_reason_check.value:
("analysis_results"."outcome" = 'accepted' and "analysis_results"."output" is not null and "analysis_results"."reason" is null)
        or ("analysis_results"."outcome" <> 'accepted' and "analysis_results"."output" is null and "analysis_results"."reason" is not null)

analysis_results_claim_all_or_none_check.name: analysis_results_claim_all_or_none_check
analysis_results_claim_all_or_none_check.value:
("analysis_results"."claim" is null and "analysis_results"."claim_confidence" is null and "analysis_results"."horizon" is null)
        or ("analysis_results"."outcome" = 'accepted' and "analysis_results"."claim" is not null
          and "analysis_results"."claim_confidence" is not null and "analysis_results"."horizon" is not null)

analysis_scores_score_xor_unscorable_che.name: analysis_scores_score_xor_unscorable_check
analysis_scores_score_xor_unscorable_che.value:
("analysis_scores"."score" is not null and "analysis_scores"."unscorable_reason" is null)
        or ("analysis_scores"."score" is null and "analysis_scores"."unscorable_reason" is not null)

decision_scores_score_xor_unscorable_che.name: decision_scores_score_xor_unscorable_check
decision_scores_score_xor_unscorable_che.value:
("decision_scores"."score" is not null and "decision_scores"."unscorable_reason" is null)
        or ("decision_scores"."score" is null and "decision_scores"."unscorable_reason" is not null)

decisions_origin_match_check.name: decisions_origin_match_check
decisions_origin_match_check.value:
("decisions"."origin_kind" = 'signal' and "decisions"."signal_id" is not null and "decisions"."contemplated_operation_id" is null and "decisions"."operation_id" is null and "decisions"."suggestion_id" is null)
        or ("decisions"."origin_kind" = 'contemplated_operation' and "decisions"."contemplated_operation_id" is not null and "decisions"."signal_id" is null and "decisions"."operation_id" is null and "decisions"."suggestion_id" is null)
        or ("decisions"."origin_kind" = 'held_operation' and "decisions"."operation_id" is not null and "decisions"."signal_id" is null and "decisions"."contemplated_operation_id" is null and "decisions"."suggestion_id" is null)
        or ("decisions"."origin_kind" = 'suggestion' and "decisions"."suggestion_id" is not null and "decisions"."signal_id" is null and "decisions"."contemplated_operation_id" is null and "decisions"."operation_id" is null)

filing_labels_topic_check.name: filing_labels_topic_check
filing_labels_topic_check.value: topic is null or topic in ('results', 'dividends', 'guidance', 'm_and_a', 'debt', 'litigation', 'management', 'buyback', 'offering', 'other')

filing_labels_tone_check.name: filing_labels_tone_check
filing_labels_tone_check.value: tone is null or tone in ('positive', 'neutral', 'negative')

filing_labels_reason_check.name: filing_labels_reason_check
filing_labels_reason_check.value: reason is null or reason in ('refusal', 'incomplete', 'schema', 'figure', 'link', 'bad_request', 'not_pdf', 'too_large', 'unavailable')

filing_labels_labelled_check.name: filing_labels_labelled_check
filing_labels_labelled_check.value: (outcome = 'labelled') = (topic is not null and tone is not null and summary is not null)

suggestion_scores_score_xor_unscorable_c.name: suggestion_scores_score_xor_unscorable_check
suggestion_scores_score_xor_unscorable_c.value:
("suggestion_scores"."score" is not null and "suggestion_scores"."unscorable_reason" is null)
        or ("suggestion_scores"."score" is null and "suggestion_scores"."unscorable_reason" is not null)
